entities.name: Jafargulu Khan Nakhchivanski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jafargulu Khan Nakhchivanski was a Russian officer and later an Azerbaijani statesman. He was the brother of General-Adjutant Huseyn Khan Nakhchivanski and father of Major General Jamshid Nakhchivanski.
